title: Per-role and per-agent model profile layers for the OpenRouter launch path
description: Committed at routing/profiles.json. The class -> model mapping lives in routing/capabilities.json; this file carries the layers that override it for one role or one agent, plus the session model. Resolution is a deep merge, later wins: capabilities.providers.openrouter.models <- defaults <- roles.<role> <- agents.<login> <- the agent's gitignored model-profile.local.json. The launcher applies the family shim (routing/shims.json) to every merged model and exports the composites under the harness aliases (runtime/claude-code/aliases.json). The review capability's merged model must be in routing/policies/review-grade.json. The vanilla `claude` path never reads this file. Credentials are never here. Authored by architect-cto like a charter.

model_id.description: A canonical model reference: `vendor/model`, a dated `vendor/model-YYYYMMDD`, a family alias `~vendor/family-latest`, or a router `openrouter/<router>`; an optional `:variant` suffix (floor, nitro, exacto) and an optional `[1m]` context hint. A preset is a SHIM, not a model, so `@preset/...` is not a model id here; the runtime attaches it.

profile.description: One layer of the merge. Every field is optional in a layer.

session.description: The main conversation's model: what `ori claude --model` receives (with its family shim) unless an explicit --model is given on the command line.

capabilities.description: Overrides of the class -> model mapping for this layer.

review.description: The merged value MUST be one of routing/policies/review-grade.json; lint and the launcher both refuse otherwise.

notes.description: Why this layer differs from the one below it — one or two sentences, for the reader of the file.

defaults.description: The bottom layer above capabilities.json. Must carry the session model.

roles.description: Per-role layer, keyed by a role id from identities/roles/catalog.json.

agents.description: Per-agent layer, keyed by the agent's Linux login (runtime/identity.py). Never a directory or clone name.
